blocks.html: The clearance reduction methods specified in Table 308.4.2 shall not be utilized to reduce the clearance required for solid fuel-burning appliances that are labeled for installation with clearances of 12 inches (304.8 mm) or less. Where appliances are labeled for installation with clearances of greater than 12 inches (304.8 mm), the clearance reduction methods of Table 308.4.2 shall not reduce the clearance to less than 12 inches (304.8 mm).
